specs.title: Home, as an admin

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Everyone lands on Home: what needs you, your responses, what we know
For admins: the answers waiting for review, as one line
It opens Knowledge, All answers, with those answers filtered

specs.title: A question for the member, sent to the owner, and the owner uses their answer

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Sarah Chen assigns "Do you give staff paid volunteering days each year?" to Tom Richardson
Tom Richardson signs in
Tom Richardson lands on Home: the question is waiting for them
Assignments opens on that question, with everything needed to answer it
Notes for the owner
The answer, sent to the owner to decide
Sarah Chen sees it on Home, under Answered by colleagues
It opens the response at that question, still to do, with their answer and Use their answer

specs.title: Hand back, with a note

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Sarah Chen assigns "What compliance certifications does your organization hold?" to Tom Richardson
Tom Richardson signs in
The question has a draft, its confidence and checker, and the answers it was drawn from
Tom Richardson is not the right person: Hand back, with a reason of at least 5 characters
Sarah Chen sees it handed back, on Home and on the question
